changes.description: Adds a case-series mode: a Chart output connected to Cases by period draws an epidemic curve, with the period on the axis and the kind of date stated in the caption. A presentation of the series with no smoothing and no interpolation.

bandMeasure: 'difference' charts the difference between neighbouring nested bands instead of their cumulative counts, and does it with a Vega-Lite window/calculate transform in the specification rather than arithmetic in the application. Nested travel-time bands give cumulative counts -- a location one minute from a pump is inside all four rings -- while the case study's own bar chart subtracts as it walks outward (Advanced-1 NB04 cell 19). A prototype that deliberately departs from the house style of charting already computed bins: the whole spec is recorded as fw:rendererSpecification, so a declared transform is more inspectable in the provenance than the same subtraction in TypeScript. It requires the Vega-Lite renderer, renames the measure, says so in the caption, keeps the cumulative count in the tooltip, and asserts a distinct fw:chartMeasureKind of band-difference-of-<kind> with unit status location-memberships-differenced-between-bands. Refused unless every bin carries a distinct travel time and the counts actually increase outward, which proves nesting from the data rather than assuming it. See docs/experiments/87-declarative-chart-transforms.md.
